# 5 female talkers who also served as listeners (crew of 5, 4 listening to each talker), 16 consonants + /a/ (as in 'father'), one syllable every 2.1 s, listeners forced to answer every syllable (guessing if necessary); 4000 observations per table. Rows = sent, columns = heard, counts (blank cells in the paper written 0). th = /T/, dh = /D/, sh = /S/, zh = /Z/. 'sum' column added here.

# condition: unfiltered (frequency response 200-6500 cps), S/N +6 dB, white noise (Table V, p. 341). The unfiltered condition with the overall correct score closest to the 200-5000 cps low-pass table (3336 vs 3332 of 4000, Table XX).
